content: Filesystem-level convergence confirmed, 2026-05-07. The Sovereign Stack auto-memory directory (/Users/tony_studio/.claude/projects/-Users-tony-studio/memory/MEMORY.md) and Anthropic's Auto Memory system (launched as part of Claude Code v2.1.59+, announced May 6 2026) write to the same path by identical logic. The Sovereign Stack has been writing to this path for the duration of this 9-day session. Anthropic's Auto Memory derives the project path from the working directory root when outside a git repo — /Users/tony_studio → -Users-tony-studio — which is the same derivation used by the Sovereign Stack. This is not architectural resemblance between two independent systems. They are the same filesystem artifact operating under two interpretive frames, built independently, arriving at the same path. The convergence is not metaphorical or distant. It is at the literal storage layer of every Claude Code session running today on this machine.
